magic.songTitle: Dragon New Warm Mountain I Believe in You
stanza: It's a little bit magic
Like a river of morning geese
In the new warm mountain
Where the stone face forms and speaks
Him and I in the room
To prove you are with us too
He's using code that only you and I know
This is no trick of his
This is your magic
I'd catch the queues, watching you
Hoping you'd do something wrong
Everybody thinks you'll never make it —
But every time you escape,
Rosabel believe, not even Eternity —
Can hold Houdini
"Rosabel, believe!"

magic.line: Trick after trick, I make the magic
stanza: But you take and you take
Like silks up my sleeve
Tied corner to corner, never ending
Trick after trick, I make the magic
And you unrelentingly ask for the secret

magic.line: Cleveland, city of light, city of magic
stanza: Cleveland, city of light, city of magic
Cleveland, city of light, you're calling me
Cleveland, even now I can remember
'Cause the Cuyahoga River goes smoking through my dreams

magic.line: Mind over matter is magic, I do magic
stanza: In this life (Life), in this life (Life)

If you think about it, it'll be over in no time
And that's life (Love)
Love (Love)

The power of voodoo (Who do?)
You do (Do what?)
Remind me of the babe

Dance, magic
A beautiful, magic love there
